samples.text: Either party may immediately terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party ceases to do business as a going concern, becomes insolvent, or files a petition under bankruptcy laws.

Vendor liability under this Agreement shall be uncapped for data breaches and willful misconduct, but Customer total aggregate liability for all claims shall not exceed five thousand dollars ($5,000).
All inventions, improvements, software developments, and discoveries made jointly by the parties in connection with this agreement shall be jointly owned without any right of accounting.
Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer against any third-party claim alleging that Customer authorized use of the SaaS Platform infringes any valid United States patent or copyright.
The obligations of non-disclosure shall survive for five (5) years from disclosure, provided that trade secrets shall remain confidential perpetually until they enter the public domain.
Customer shall not actively poach or hire Vendor senior systems architects for eighteen (18) months following delivery, except pursuant to general public job postings.
This agreement shall be governed by Singapore law and any controversy shall be submitted to binding arbitration under SIAC rules in Singapore.
Customer may withhold payment of disputed charges provided Customer gives written notice within 10 days and pays all undisputed amounts on time.
Customer designates Vendor as its exclusive provider of enterprise compliance auditing within the European Union territory.
Customer may audit Vendor SOC2 compliance reports once annually upon thirty (30) days notice during regular business hours.
A merger, consolidation, or sale of substantially all assets shall not trigger a termination right provided the successor entity possesses equal or greater creditworthiness.
This Master Services Agreement is entered into as of May 12, 2026, by and between CloudScale Inc. ('Vendor') and Apex Enterprises LLC ('Customer').
All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and deemed duly given when delivered by recognized overnight courier or registered mail to the addresses set forth above.
This Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original. If any provision is held unenforceable, remaining terms remain in full force.
This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements, oral or written.
